input: This is synthetic workshop roleplay. I propose a scheduling tool for my 20-person dance club after personally missing a rehearsal. I can reach five members. Existing group chat has polls but two members said they missed a changed time; recurrence and switching remain unverified. I want chat, profiles, payments, badges, reminders, a calendar, and analytics. Narrow it and propose one concrete test now.
